text:
maria: Oncall handoff — seeing missing child spans on prefetcher requests, some end-to-end traces only show root span. High p99 latency too. Where's the fastest place to look (logs/traces/dashboards) and who can flip a temporary sampler override?
ajay: Check Grafana -> Observability -> Traces (tempo) first. I usually filter by service:prefetcher and trace.duration > 500ms. Link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/obs/traces?var-service=prefetcher
taylor: Also look at the prefetcher Pod logs in k8s: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/prefetcher -c prefetcher --since=1h` — sometimes the worker swallows OTEL context on error.
leo: Quick sanity: confirm OTEL SDK version on the pods. We had a mismatch (otel 1.12 vs 1.15) causing propagator differences. `kubectl exec -it ... -- prefetcher --version` works.
caroline: If you want to relax sampling immediately, we can set a per-deployment sampler override in the tracing-config map: `sampler: parentbased(always_on)` for 15m. I'll need an owner to approve if it might increase billing. @ajay?
ajay: I can approve small override for oncall investigation. If we do it: 1) update `tracing-config` k8s CM, 2) roll patch to prefetcher canary only, 3) watch traces and cost dashboard (alerts will catch large delta).
maria: Thanks — can someone drop the exact dashboard and logs links here and a tiny checklist I can follow during handoff? I'm on rotation til 11:00 PT.
ajay: Dashboard links: Traces (tempo) above, Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/app/Kibana#/discover?_a=(query:(match:(kubernetes.container_name:(query:prefetcher)))) , Metrics: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/obs/prefetcher-metrics?var-service=prefetcher
leo: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm OTEL envs: `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp` `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service=prefetcher,env=prod` 2) Check propagator: `OTEL_PROPAGATORS=tracecontext,baggage` 3) Look for errors in logs mentioning "context deadline exceeded" or "span context lost" 4) If needed, apply sampler override to canary only
caroline: If override applied, set a 15m rollback window and add an alert mute for the billing spike channel for that window. I'll handle alert mute if ajay posts the PR link.
maria: I tried `OTEL_PROPAGATORS` earlier and it was set, but saw a bunch of WARNs about `instrumentation/opentelemetry: failed to inject` — attaching snippet from logs.
(attach): WARN prefetcher/instrumentation.go:45 failed to inject traceparent for req id=abc123
ajay: That log matches an older helper lib we shipped. I can open a tiny PR to use the newer propagation helper — will ping codeowners. @taylor can you glance at the change?
taylor: Yep I can review, ping me in PR. If we want a faster path, try restarting the canary with the newer image tag `prefetcher:v2026-02-17-hotfix` — it's been tested.
maria: Great. I'll follow the checklist, watch the trace view, and hold off on the override unless the canary restart doesn't show child spans. Will update in 15m. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy started for prefetcher canary by ajay — build bld-7654. ETA ~2m.
caroline: Noted — oncall rota: @maria you have handoff until 11:00 PT, @leo you're backup after that. If anything escalates to infra, ping #eng-infra.
ajay: PR created: https://git.redwood/internal/prefetcher/pulls/322 — small prop helper change. @taylor please review when free.
maria: Thanks all, will report back after canary completes. If still missing spans I'll ask for the sampler override and tag billing.
leo: If spans still missing after restart, run `tempo query` with `trace_id` and check for orphaned child spans in Jaeger UI too. Sometimes storage sharding causes delayed retrieval.
maria: Update: canary restarted and I can see child spans for ~10 traces already, p99 latency improving. Leaving the canary running for 20m then will roll. Closing loop after handoff. :white_check_mark:
